description: Source code for LegacyWiFiManagerAPIs.cpp implementing WiFi management APIs, event handling, and interaction with NetworkManager in a C++ project.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class for executing functions asynchronously.

classes.name: WiFiManager
classes.description: Main class implementing WiFi management APIs, event subscriptions, and event handling.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WiFiManager, sets up dependencies, and subscribes to events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters methods, and resets state.

methods.name: registerLegacyMethods
methods.description: Registers JSON RPC methods for WiFi operations.

methods.name: unregisterLegacyMethods
methods.description: Unregisters JSON RPC methods.

methods.name: cancelWPSPairing
methods.description: Cancels ongoing WPS pairing process.

methods.name: clearSSID
methods.description: Removes known SSID from the list.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the currently connected SSID information.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Gets the current WiFi state.

methods.name: getPairedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves a known SSID.

methods.name: getPairedSSIDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info of the connected SSID.

methods.name: getSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Returns supported security modes.

methods.name: isPaired
methods.description: Checks if the device is paired with any SSID.

methods.name: saveSSID
methods.description: Saves an SSID to known list.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Starts WiFi scan with optional filters.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Stops ongoing WiFi scan.

methods.name: retrieveSSID
methods.description: Reads SSID info from wpa_supplicant.conf file.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to WiFi-related events from NetworkManager.

methods.name: ErrorCodeMapping
methods.description: Maps internal WiFi state codes to legacy error codes.

methods.name: onWiFiStateChange
methods.description: Handles WiFi state change events and posts notifications.

methods.name: onAvailableSSIDs
methods.description: Handles available SSIDs event and posts notifications.

methods.name: onWiFiSignalQualityChange
methods.description: Handles WiFi signal quality change events.
